label: Diagram 2.2
caption: Diagram 2.2 Alternative escape routes | Inner rooms
description: This is a plan, labelled in a green band at the bottom as "Diagram 2.2 Alternative escape routes", with the note "See para 2.10" at the top left. The plan shows a room bounded by thick black walls, with a gap in the top wall. Five points are marked with small green squares: A at the top left corner, B at the top wall beside the gap, E at the top right corner, C on the bottom wall, and D on the right wall. Solid green lines run from C to A and from C to B; from D a dashed line runs to A and a solid line to B, and a solid line runs from E to B. An angle symbol at C, between the lines to A and B, is marked "> 45°". An angle symbol at D, between the lines to A and B, is marked "< 45°". To the right, the text says alternative escape routes are available from C because angle ACB is 45 degrees or more, so distance CA or CB (whichever is less) should be no more than the maximum travel distance for alternative escape routes; they are not available from D because angle ADB is less than 45 degrees (see Diagram 2.1); and there is no alternative escape route from E. No dimensions are given for the walls or the gap.
